events.title: NFL Down Under Package
events.description: Book our 4-hour food & beverage package for the LA Rams and San Fran. 49-ers game happening down under! Schooners of Coors, roaming platters, a chance to win a 49-ers jersey, and the game live & loud on our big screen. 18+ Event. Terms and conditions apply. The Caxton promotes the responsible service and consumption of alcohol. Book now!
